Irene: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing an "ownership escrow" pattern for multi-region writes (lighter than full consensus). Idea: escrow KV points at owner region + short-lived consent tokens + provisional local writes for eventual mode. Thoughts? :thinking:

Priya: Sounds promising. How does a proxy choose between sync-forward and provisional?

Irene: Per-tenant policy in control-plane. Modes: owner-only, sync-with-consent, eventual. Proxies cache policy + consent token. If owner==local -> local commit. If owner!=local and mode==sync-with-consent and token present -> forward. If token missing and mode==eventual -> provisional+enqueue.

Dan: Need quick revocation when owner flips or policy changes. Can't rely on TTLs alone.

Irene: We add an epoch to tokens. Control-plane bumps epoch on change; proxies validate epoch on manifest refresh or on hard revocation webhook. Also expose a revocation fanout to edge proxies for fast eviction.

Priya: Database invariants (seq ids, unique constraints)? Owner region must be authoritative. Provisional writes get a provisional id and later get reconciled/mapped to owner ids. If conflict, reconciliation emits compensating ops.

Dan: Pseudo proxy flow would help.

Irene: Short pseudo: \n```\nmanifest = getPolicy(tenant)\nif escrow.owner == local: commitLocal()\nelse if manifest.mode == \"owner-only\": return 403\nelse if hasValidConsent(token) and manifest.mode == \"sync-with-consent\": forwardToOwner(timeout=200ms)\nelse if manifest.mode == \"eventual\": writeProvisional(); enqueueReconcile(); return 202\nelse return 409\n```\n
Priya: Telemetry: emit `residency.decision` (local/forward/provisional) and `residency.reconcile_lag_ms`. Also tag by tenant and policy for rollout metrics.

Dan: Compliance: escrow entries for PII-tenants must be KMS-encrypted; cross-region forwards emit audit events to tenant sink.

ops-bot: ran quick sim (5k reqs/tenant) -> with 65% token hit-rate forwarded p95 improved ~35%. Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/sims/ownership-escrow/3678901234

Irene: OK owners: Priya -> control-plane manifests & revocation fanout; Dan -> reconciliation worker; Dan+Priya -> canary plan. I'll write a brief RFC addendum with sequence diagrams. Thanks. :rocket:

deploy-bot: artifacts -> https://ci.redwood/sims/ownership-escrow/3678901234/artifacts.json
